newsitem.title: USA: Chrysler to invest $178 mln in stamping plant.
newsitem.headline: Chrysler to invest $178 mln in stamping plant.

text.p: Chrysler Corp. said Tuesday it will invest $178 million to modernize and expand its metal stamping plant in Sterling Heights, Mich.

Chrysler said it broke ground Tuesday on a 61,200-square-foot, $25 million addition to the plant. When completed in 1998, the new building will initially house one large Verson progressive press multi-stage dies capable of producing finished parts from coiled steel.

Chrysler said modernization in the present plant will take place over the next two years with the addition of two new "A+ size" Schuler transfer presses -- among the largest in the world. It also will include one "B+ size" Verson transfer press along with two 1,000-ton and one 1,500-ton Schuler presses.
The Sterling Stamping Plant, which feeds several assembly plants in the region, currently employs 3,420 people.
